paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Israelte Hun Tawp Naina

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, Toupa PATHIAN in Israel gam kiang ah hichi in achi: Tawpna, tawpna gam ning li ah ahong tung hi.
"Tu nang a ding in tawpna ahi, na tung ah ka hehna ka hon tungsak ding a, na omdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding a, na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
Ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi; na omdan bang in na tung ah ka hon tun zaw ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Siatna, siatgawpna mah, ngai dih, ahong tung hi.
Tawpna ahong tung hi, tawpna ahong tung hi, na tung ah ahong thouta, ngai in, ahong tung hi.
Aw gam luahpa, na siatna ding na tung ah ahong tung hi, hun ahong tung hi, ni anaita hi; buaina, kipak a tang tung a kikouna ni hilou.
"Tu in ka hehna na tung ah ka hon buakzok ding hi, na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a; na omdan bang zel in ka hon vai hawmsak ding hi; na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.

Huan ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding; na omdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hon tun ding a, na kihhuaina leng na lak uah a-om ding; huchi in kei TOUPA gawt theipa ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Ngai in, ani, ngai in, ahong tung hi, na siatna ding apawtta, satna chiang apakta, kisaktheihna apakmumta hi.
Hiamgamna gitlouhna chiang asuakta ahi; kua mahmah a-omta kei ding a, ahusa uhiam, ahauhsakna uhiam leng; kuamah in a-it sam kei ding uh.
"Hun ahong tungta, ani ahong naita; aleimi kipak kei henla, akhawngmi leng dah kei hen; thangpaihna avek ua tung ah a-omta hi.
Azuakmi in, dam lai mahleh, athil zuak amu nawn kei ding; muhkholhna zaw avek ua tungthu ahi a, kuamah akik kei ding uh, kuamah ahinna thulimlouhna uah akhosa suak sam kei ding uh.
Pengkul amut ua, bangkim akimanta; himahleh kidouna ah kuamah ahoh kei uh; avek ua tung a ka hehna a-om ziak in.
"Inpua ah namsau, asung ah hipi leh kial; gam a om namsau in asi ding ua, khopi a om kial leh hipi in ane khin ding hi.
heading: Israel Khelhna Ziak A Sawina

paite: Himahleh ataikhete, apawt ding ua, tangte ah phaizang gam vakhu bang in; avek un, lungzuangtak in amau thulimlouhna chiat ah a-om ding uh.
Khut tengteng azaw ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in anem ding.
Sai-ip puan ateng ding ua, mulkimna in amau atuam ding a, mel chiteng ah zumna alang ding a, alutang tengteng uh agiau khin ding hi.
Adangkasik uh leh adangka-engte un TOUPA heh ni chiang in ahunkhe thei kei ding a, ahinna uh ataisak kei ding a, agil uh avahsak sam kei ding; athulimlouhna uh pukna ahih khit tak ziak in.
Akizepna kilawmna uh akisaktheihpih ua, akihhuaina milim un leh anitna thil un asuaksak zaw lel uhi; huaiziak in amau a ding in thilkihhuai ding in ka na bawlta hi.
"Huan gallak ding in namdang khut ah ka pe dia, lei a migiloute kiang ah gallak ding in ka pe ding a, amau ana hihnin ding uh.
Amaute ka nungngatsan ding a, ka mun siang ahihnin ding uh; huan guta ahong lut dia, ahihnin ding uh.
"Gamsung lah sisan suah hat vaihawmna a dim a, hiamgamna a khopi adim ziak in khainiang bawl un.
Huchi in namdang giloupente ka hon pilut ding a a-innte uh aneihsak ding ua; ahatna otpih uh ka hihtawp ding a, amun siangte uh hihnit in a-om ding hi.
Lungzinna ahong tung a, muanna azong ua, a-om het kei hi.
Siatna tung ah siatsemna, thuthang tung ah thuthang ahong om ding a, zawlnei lak ah kilakna azong ding ua, himahleh dante siampu lak ah amang ding a, upate lak ah thudot a-om kei ding hi.

Kumpipa adah ding a, kumpi tapa lungdonna puansilh in akivan ding a, vantang khut leng aling ding. Akiang uah a-omdan bang un ka hih ding a, athilhih bang zel un vai ka hawmsak ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih atheita ding uh," achi hi.
